title: Add versioned cacheKey to CachedNetworkImage call sites
objective: Make cached image keys include a stable version component so avatar and block image rotations invalidate disk/memory cache entries.
acceptance_criteria: Every CachedNetworkImage call site passes an explicit cacheKey
Every CachedNetworkImageProvider call site passes an explicit cacheKey when supported
cacheKey values combine image URL with a version source such as updatedAt, entity id, or another stable invalidation suffix
No new image-loading package is introduced
flutter analyze for edited image widgets reports no new errors
deliverables: Versioned cache keys in app_avatar.dart, block_card.dart, and block_details_screen.dart
